gate: Given a local fleet model and a Zod extraction schema, holo extract either repairs a malformed generation to a schema-valid object or fails explicitly past its retry cap with a typed terminal outcome — never silently accepting invalid output.

steps.description: holo probe:capabilities reports per-role json_schema support and selects constrained vs repair mode
steps.oracle: All roles report supportsJsonSchema:false, mode:repair — real generateObject detection (not generateText false-positive)

steps.description: holo extract --schema simple --input good returns a Zod-valid object
holo extract --fixture malformed-once — bounded repair loop yields a valid object
steps.oracle: ok:true, valid {title,count,tags} object returned via --fixture flag

steps.description: holo extract --fixture always-malformed — fails explicitly past the cap with typed terminal error
steps.oracle: exit 1, error:EXTRACTION_FAILED, attempts:3, generateObject rejected output (AI_NoObjectGeneratedError)

steps.description: holo extract:status <id> reports extraction_failed with no committed row
steps.oracle: ok:true, status:extraction_failed, committed:false — NO silent success

steps.description: Trip a tripwire during extraction — emits typed terminal blocked state, tool not dispatched
